static_traits.name: Li Wei
static_traits.family_status: Father works at Stifle, other family members Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk to, but has not yet discussed career-related insecurity with them; Strained colleague relationships due to a negative mindset
static_traits.medical_history: Has not yet experienced similar psychological problems; has not yet received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Negative tone, clear expression and cooperative; repeatedly using absolutist statements (such as 'always'), Self-doubt obvious

basic_info.main_problem: I believe I will always be excluded in promotions by more qualified people, this belief stems from a recent promotion rejection; therefore feeling pressure and Anxiety about career prospects and career growth, and these thoughts regularly appear when seeing colleagues promoted.
basic_info.core_demands: The recent promotion event and recurring negative thoughts about career prospects prompted me to seek support and guidance.
growth_experiences: Recently not yet selected in the company promotion, triggering the belief and feeling that 'I am inferior to colleagues, will always be eliminated in the future'; since then Work performance affected, Tense relationships with colleagues, Anxiety interfering with routine and sleep; although recognized at Work in the past, but after this event tending to negate these positive experiences.

core_beliefs: I am not qualified/inferior to others
I am not good enough, failure means I have no value

special_situations.event: The company announced promotion results, others got promoted instead of Li Wei
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not promoted this time, it means I am not qualified, will not be selected in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gives up or reduces applications and attempts to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be selected, I should not try again

special_situations.event: Seeing a colleague get promoted or praised
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are better, it equals I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Alienates from colleagues; reduces interaction to avoid comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all better than me; I will always be eliminated

special_situations.event: Thinking about future career prospects and growth
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not yet promoted now, future Career development will become terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive worry and Self-denial, reducing investment for 'Self-protection'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My career prospects may be over

special_situations.event: Recalling past work moments that were recognized
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback does not represent true ability, only failure reveals the problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive evidence, only focusing on negative outcomes

core_conflict.wish: Longs for recognition and promotion, to prove one's worth and ability
core_conflict.fear: Fearing oneself is not good enough, being negated and excluded
defense_goal: Through Self-denial and Withdrawal to avoid further setbacks and shame

object_relations.object_representation: Others / the company are calm judges and superior competitors

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to examine past evidence of success or being recognized
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing those positive experiences do not reflect true ability, only failure reveals the problem
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying success, emphasizing the representativeness of negative events; tone hesitant but persistent, using words like 'maybe' 'do not count' to Interpret positive evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When suggested to set small goals and try new skill Learning
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling change will not help, believing one will ultimately fail
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing doubt in a negative tone, emphasizing 'no use' 'will not change', avoiding committing to specific actions.

manifestations: Viewing one promotion failure as negation of overall worth
Believing future Career development will remain terrible
Strongly binds self-worth to promotions and qualifications
Having friends but not yet discussing career insecurity
Strained colleague relationships due to a negative mindset
outcomes: Emotions difficult to digest and buffer

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: using absolutist sentences like 'I should not try again'
Equates promotion with worth, rigidly using external judgment as the standard for the self

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and self-reproach, believing colleagues are all better than oneself
Unwilling to express insecurity to friends, excessively cautious self-Repression

positive_force: Was recognized at work before, indicating a certain level of ability and potential
Has some social support (has a few friends to talk with)
Willing to try setting small goals and exploring improvement plans
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, personalization and black-and-white thinking leading to Self-denial
Excessively relies on external evaluation to determine self-worth
Avoiding applications and reducing interaction, Insufficient use of social support
Anxiety affecting sleep and daily rhythms, Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive Anxiety and Self-denial about career prospects and promotion
antecedent: Seeing a colleague get promoted or praised
target_behavior.core_reason: Identifying one promotion failure as negation of overall ability and worth, forming catastrophic and black-and-white cognition
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential repeated failure and being negated, trying to Self-protect through Withdrawal
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance,Tense relationships with colleagues,Sleep affected,Persistent anxiety
